title: CLCON/664/2019 of DINESH VARMA Vs R MEENAKSHI SUNDARAM

paras.text:
CLCON No.664 of 2019
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Bharat Singh, Advocate for the
petitioners.
 Petitioners had filed a writ petition before
this Court being Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1019
of 2019 as they were not being given the
dearness allowance for certain period as well
as the arrears of salary of 7th Pay Commission.
 The said writ petition was disposed of by
a learned Single Judge of this Court vide order
dated 06.05.2019 directing the Director,
Secondary Education, Dehradun to decide the
representation of the petitioners. There was no
other direction.
 Now it is an admitted case that pursuant to
the order passed by this Court, the petitioners
moved a representation before the Director,
Secondary Education, Dehradun, which has
been decided by the Director, Secondary
Education, Dehradun on 28.08.2019. The
petitioners, however, not satisfied with the
outcome of the order inasmuch as they claim
that arrears of salary of 7th Pay Commission
and dearness allowance as ought to have been
given, has not been given.
 In view of this Court, though the
petitioners may still have a claim on that and
for that they may file a separate writ petition,
but presently no contempt is made out.
 Consequently, the contempt petition fails
and it is hereby dismissed in limine.
